title: Sibling stale line citation in patterns.md US-003 bullet: cites test/dispatch.test.ts:754 but that line is now an unrelated AC1 assertion
description:
Discovered during CAM-380 grounding (measured on main after PR #318 / v0.242.0). The US-003 bullet in scripts/cam/patterns.md (tagged US-003, CAM-376, 2026-07-20; adjacent above the US-R1-002 bullet CAM-380 fixed) cites `test/dispatch.test.ts:754` as the location of the OLD historical assertion `recordedSleeps.every((ms) => ms <= 1_000)`. MEASURED on main: line 754 now holds an unrelated AC1 assertion `expect(sendKeysCalls).toHaveLength(1)`; the recordedSleeps region has drifted to ~776-777. So `:754` is stale, exactly the same rot defect CAM-380 just fixed one bullet down.

Note: CAM-380's own description mistakenly asserted `:754` was 'correct as a HISTORICAL main-referencing citation, must not be touched' -- that premise was already false on main, which is why CAM-380 was scoped to `:769` only and this was carved out as a separate follow-up.

SCOPE: convert the `test/dispatch.test.ts:754` pointer in the US-003 bullet to a rot-proof grep-able content reference (drop the :NNN suffix, anchor on the assertion text the bullet already quotes), per the same derive-don't-freeze precedent at patterns.md:903 and content-reference precedent at patterns.md:913 that CAM-380 followed. Doc-only, NO rebuild.

ORACLE NOTE for whoever specs this: do NOT re-freeze a new line number; verify with an absence grep of the stale `test/dispatch.test.ts:754` token plus content-greps that the cited assertion text resolves in both patterns.md and test/dispatch.test.ts. Do NOT target scripts/cam/handoff.json (rotating). Re-measure current line numbers on main before speccing -- they drift.

Source: CAM-380 grounding, 2026-07-21
